ratings.note: Today is the default day and same-day booking is common (f2); a slot that has already started is accepted, leading to late rejection or an unusable booking (i2); recurs daily but can be learned (p1).
Only residents who adjust waste at the last step (f1); they have to guess, but the 'Change vehicle' page does hold the waste list (i1); can be learned (p1).
Every booking holds a slot and residents often book while doing something else (f2); the slot is lost at the last step, though details are kept (i2); once known it can be beaten (p1).

Every completed booking (f3; the screenshot shows only the reference); the screen shown at the gate lacks the time and vehicle, so a resident may arrive at the wrong time (i2); p1. Rated 3 rather than s=4 because the confirm step and the SMS reminder carry the details.

Every day view that has Few left slots (f3; the 375 screenshot shows 10 slots, including 13:40 to 16:40, above Morning); grouping and order can be misread (i2); p1. Rated 3 rather than s=4 because every button shows its time, so a wrong booking is unlikely.
Only residents who use Change slot at confirm (f1); the fresh page suggests the booking was discarded, so they may re-enter details or give up (i2); p1.
Every held slot, and pausing residents are common (f2); the slot is lost without explanation (i2); p1.

Residents whose plans change; changing a booking is a core task (f2); the only route is a phone line open on weekdays only, which counts as a support contact and blocks evenings and weekends (i3); built into the design (p2).
Screen-reader users on every step (f1); the progress cue is missing, though the heading lets them infer where they are (i1); p1.
The same reordering seen in the 375 screenshot (f3); the Morning grid seems to have gaps where free slots exist (i2); p1. Rated 3 rather than s=4 because the times are visible on every button.

Every slot (f3); the end time and arrival rule are only in a tooltip, but the intro says 'the 20-minute slot you will arrive in' (i1); p1. Rated 2 rather than s=3 because the rule is visible in the intro.
Van and trailer residents without a permit (f1); they must search the council site before they can book (i2); once per resident (p0).
Same-day bookings, with Today as the default (f2); rejected only after all three steps are done (i2); can be learned (p1).
A token mismatch on every day view (f3); no harm to users beyond the contrast issue, which is rated separately (i0); with impact 0, s is capped at 1.
Cancelled bookings that are reopened; the double-tap cancellation makes this more frequent (f1); the heading contradicts the status line, though the line is present (i2); p1.
Van and trailer bookings with a mistyped permit (f1); the error comes late, has no link, and forces a backtrack (i2); p1.
Every car booking, which is most bookings (f3); a permit field shown for a car causes hesitation, though it can be ignored once understood (i1); p1.
Residents with only a landline, or who skip the field; many residents are older (f1); landline-only residents cannot book at all (i3); learning does not help (p2).
Expired holds only (f1); the message gives no next step, but 'Change slot' sits beside the blank Slot row and details are kept (i1); p1.
Low-vision residents on every day view (f2); 'Few left' at about 3:1 may be unreadable, though the coloured fill remains (i1); learning does not help (p2).
The same expired-hold state (f1); the error is unexplained but recoverable through Change slot (i1); p1.
Forced-colours users only (f0); the selected day is hard to tell apart, but the date line repeats it (i1); recurs and is not overcome (p2).
Every booking (f3); 1.3 to 1.5 s with no feedback invites a second tap (i1); p1.
Only after a mistyped date that follows an earlier search (f0); stale text sits beside a clear error (i1); p0.
Everyone who changes slot or steps back (f2); the day silently resets to Today, so they may book the wrong day (i2); p1.

Every completed booking (f3; the screenshot shows only the reference); the gate screen lacks the arrival time (i2); p1. Rated 3 rather than s=4 because the confirm step and SMS reminder carry the time.
Keyboard and switch users (f1); no focus cue on the main choice, so they may pick the wrong slot (i2); learning does not help (p2).
Every day change (f3); the list is blank under the old date for less than a second (i1); p1. Rated 2 rather than s=3 because it clears on its own within about a second.
Every day change (f3); about 1 s of blank area (i1); p1. Rated 2 rather than s=3 because it is brief and clears on its own.
Every day change and every booking (f3); 1 to 1.5 s of unclear state invites repeat taps (i1); p1.
Phones 360 px wide or less are common on Android (f2); the grid overflows by about 32 px, causing sideways scrolling or a clipped column (i1); every visit (p2).
Every booking (f3); residents must remember the slot, but the confirm step shows it (i1); p1. Rated 2 rather than s=3 because the slot reappears one step later without any action.
Any double tap or second press within 1.5 s (f1); the booking silently becomes cancelled while the page says Booked, so the resident is turned away with a loaded car (i3); p1.
